summary: NICE Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching its Q1 2026 earnings press release. The release reports 10% year-over-year revenue growth (to $768.6M), 14.6% cloud revenue growth, and a 66% increase in AI ARR. It also mentions $253M in share repurchases during Q1 and an upward revision to full-year 2026 EPS guidance. No M&A, restructuring, or other special-situation event is announced; this is an ordinary quarterly earnings update.
